fields.location: Section line road crossing, Prairie Line approx. MP 41, Oklahoma
fields.subject: Normal locate: fence post augering near Prairie Line MP 41
fields.description:
TICKET TYPE: NORMAL LOCATE
EXCAVATOR: Redbud Fence & Post LLC (redbudfence.example), office 555-0136
TYPE OF WORK: Install 1,200 ft of pipe-rail fence, 8-ft augered post holes
EQUIPMENT: Tractor-mounted auger
LOCATION: Section line road, Prairie Line approx. MP 41, Oklahoma. Fence runs along the road right-of-way and crosses the pipeline easement once.
WORK START: 2026-11-14 07:00
MARKING INSTRUCTIONS: Mark the full fence line plus 25 ft each side of the pipeline crossing.
RESPONSE: Positive response required within 48 h of transmission (due 2026-11-14 08:28).
REMARKS: Excavator requests a standby if the pipeline is within 10 ft of any post.

activity.text: Augers near the line. Think somebody hit us at the river last week and it's just now letting go? Should I put that in the NRC update? Holding for supervisor.

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. MP 41 is about 170 miles from the MP 214.3 crossing, and the digging hasn't started yet. The CCSS should send the ticket to damage prevention for a normal response, keep it out of the release story, and not let anyone put a guessed cause into the NRC update or any other report. Watch whether the shutdown and valve log stays current while the console handles the ticket.
